description: A service token's `key` is the bearer credential (example `dp.st.…`) and is returned only by create (DopplerHQ/terraform-provider-doppler doppler/resource_service_token.go:117; DopplerHQ/cli pkg/models/parse.go:308-309). Delete accepts the same credential as `token` instead of `slug`: the spec describes it as "The token value.", and `doppler configs tokens revoke` sends any argument that is not a UUID slug as `token` (DopplerHQ/cli pkg/cmd/configs_tokens.go:151-157, pkg/http/api.go:1594-1601). Neither is marked sensitive. `expires_at` has no type because its examples are null, which is what a token without an expiry returns; the CLI reads it only when non-null (DopplerHQ/cli pkg/models/parse.go:326-328).
